_comment: Ticker renames: same company, new trading symbol (rebrand or exchange change). The daily refresh rewrites the OLD symbol to the NEW one (sync_dolthub.py) so earnings history carries over seamlessly, and the integrity gate treats the old symbol's disappearance as expected. Distinct from config/delisted_tickers.json, which removes companies that stopped trading entirely. Loaded via scripts/delisted.py. Format: OLD -> { new, reason, renamed_on, source }.

BK.reason: BNY Mellon corporate rebrand; NYSE ticker BK -> BNY.
BK.source: auto-detected (company still listed under BNY in NYSE directory)

EXPI.reason: eXp World Holdings changed its Nasdaq ticker EXPI -> AGNT.
EXPI.source: auto-detected (company still listed under AGNT in NASDAQ directory)

IAC.reason: IAC Inc. rebranded to People Incorporated; Nasdaq ticker IAC -> PPLI.

LEG.reason: Somnigroup International completed its all-stock combination with Leggett & Platt; NYSE ticker LEG ceased trading and the business continues under NYSE: SGI.

VSCO.reason: Victoria's Secret & Co. ticker change NYSE VSCO -> VSXY.

ASGN.reason: ASGN rebranded to Everforth, Inc.; NYSE ticker ASGN -> EFOR.

FDP.reason: Ticker symbol change FDP -> DMC; same company, earnings history carried over.

SATS.reason: EchoStar Corporation changed its Nasdaq ticker SATS -> ECHO; not a delisting. Reclassified from config/delisted_tickers.json so earnings history carries over.
